tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun rig gi bdag mdun bum gsum gyi mjug tu ji ltar bya ba'i phyag len thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/

gang gi cho ga'i lta ci/ gzungs dang mtshan tsam brjod pas kyang*/ ngan song sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa/ /rnam snang lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /pha mes phor ba gtsang 'dzin gyi/ /dpe tshul tsam zhig mi 'dzin par/ /mkhas pa'i srol bzhin shes 'dod la/ /cho ga'i zur rgyan bshad par bya/ /de yang mdun bskyed kyi mjug tu bdag bum gnyis kyi gshegs gsol dang mdun bskyed la brtan bzhugs mdzad pa'i tshul da lta phyag len du dar ba bzhin te 'dir mi brjod kyang*/ bdag mdun bum gsum so so'i mjug tu ji ltar bya ba'i tshul tsam mkhas pa'i bzhed pa bzhin bshad par bya'o/ /'di la gsum/ bdag bskyed dang*/ bum bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi mjug tu ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'dul 'dzin pa'i bzhed pa ltar/ bdag bskyed kyi bsnyen pa'i mjug tu yig brgya dang mchod bstod byas rjes su/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnam 'di dag gis/ /zhes sogs gcig gi mthar/ ma rnyed zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol byas te mchod yon phul rjes/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya spyi bo nas gyen du bkrol te/ oṃ badzra sa twa badzra muḥye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥdam tshig pa rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsams la/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal cig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ nas/ sarba bid hūṃ zhes gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ byang phyogs sems dpa'i phyag rgya dang gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya 'dir ma byas kyang chog go /des na bdag bskyed kyi mjug tu bsdu tshul de ltar dgos pa cho ga'i dgongs pa yin pas legs shing*/ der ma zad cho ga gzhan gyi rigs 'gros sbyar na'ang 'thad ba'i phyir da lta mjug gi bar rang dgar 'jog pa 'di cung mi legs so/

/gnyis pa bum bskyed ni/ da lta'i phyag len du cho ga rdzogs pa'i bar 'jog pa 'di/ spyir 'thad mi 'thad pa brtag par bya ste/ bu ston dang 'dul 'dzin pa'i cho gar bum pa bsgrubs nas gshegs gsol dang 'od zhu gang yang mi mdzad par btang snyoms su bzhag pa ltar snang zhing*/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis tshul 'di mi legs te/ de ltar 'jog pa ni mkhas grub rje'i gsung 'bum thor bu las rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ma gshegs par bsdus pa dang 'dra bas don ma yin pa chen po bskyed pa'i lag len dang zhes bkag cing*/ mdun bskyed ma yin par bdag bum gnyis lta bu la phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab nas mthar dam rgya ma bkrol na lha btson du bzung ba lta bu'i nyes par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes gsungs nas/ bum bskyed kyi mjug tu dam rgya bkrol te 'od zhu bya bar bshad do/ /'on kyang 'dul 'dzin pa'i ṭika chen las/ rnal 'byor rgyud man chad du bum pa'i lha bzhu bar ma bshad ces 'byung yang 'di drang don du 'grel te/ tshe dpag med dang rnam 'joms sogs bya rgyud kyi cho ga du mar bum lha bzhu bar bshad cing*/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dkyil chog slob dpon byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa las bum pa'i lha bzhu bar bshad pa ltar mkhas grub rjes kyang gsungs la/ smṛ tis bsgyur ba'i kun snying gi cho ga las kyang*/ de nas lha 'od zhu byas te/ byang chub ye shes chu ru gyur/ /zhes 'byung ngo*/ /'od zhu byed pa'i dus ni/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs cho ga gzhan gyi rigs pa sbyar na ni bum pa'i mjug nyid du 'thad la/ 'od zhu mi byed par gshegs na yang skabs de nyid du rigs so/ /cis kyang cho ga'i mjug tu byed na ni 'od zhu byed dam mi byed na dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam dgos so/ /dam rgya bkro tshul la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshe lha re re dang sbyar pa'i dam rgya bkro tshul rgyas pa de bya dgos shing bdag bskyed la bsdus pas chog pa cho ga'i dgongs pa yin pa ltar bum bskyed la yang 'dra'o/

/de yang bum bskyed kyi mjug tu mchod bstod byas rjes sngar ltar bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ ma rnyed ces sogs kyi bzod gsol byas nas mchod yon phul te/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra sa twa badzra muḥbum lha'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur ces brjod cing bsam/ de las bsdu na/ mchod bstod kyi mjug de ma thag oṃ khyod kyis sems can zhes sogs man chad tsam gyis kyang chog go /mdun bskyed kyi mthar ras bris la bzod gsol dang brtan bzhugs byas pa'i 'jug der/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs dang byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi'i sngags brjod pa dang sems dpa'i gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya 'ching ba sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /'di na kun rig cho ga yi/ /bdag mdun bum bskyed so so'i mthar/ /bsdu tshul ji ltar bya ba'i rim/ /mkhas pa'i bzhes tshul mdor bsdus bshad/ /ces pa 'di ni cho ga'i 'dod cha'i khyad par la blo byang ba'i gnas brtan dge 'dun bzang pos rang gzhan la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas bskul ba ltar bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba yi ge ba ni dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/kun rig gi bdag mdun bum gsum gyi mjug tu ji ltar bya ba'i phyag len thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 204--PAGE 203--PAGE 201-
